verdict.rationale: Bland's own docs cover each building block of the story: prompting via conversational pathways, picking a built-in voice or cloning one, and creating inbound phone numbers or connecting them via Twilio or the CLI. A 'build your first agent' guide also exists. However, that guide only evidences testing via 'talk in browser', not a live phone call, and nothing shows the end-to-end flow fits within an hour. Missing for 10: evidence of a sub-hour time-to-first-live-call, a documented quickstart ending in a real phone call, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: Give your agent instructions on how it should respond at specific points of the conversation. Choose between prompting or fixed sentences.
Pick a built-in voice, clone your own, and set its defaults.
Create inbound phone numbers for customer support, etc.
Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
Talk in browser uses your computer's microphone. It asks for permission, then listens.
